purpose: Machine-readable contract for AI workers executing UI Forge inside Synapse.

phases.goal: Understand the real product before editing.
Recover or define the product-native design system and experience direction.
Choose bounded implementation slices and verification surfaces.
Implement the smallest coherent slice and preserve behavior/data truth.
Exercise the running app as a real desktop/mobile user.
Score the running result and detect structural drift.
Repair the highest-leverage root cause or stop when the evidence gate passes.
Persist reusable design knowledge and recurring workflow friction.

precision_edit.rule: Edit the smallest owning source/token/prop that explains the rendered issue, then rerender immediately.

safe_operations: set_text on one static JSX text child
class_tokens on a static class/className string
replace_class on a static class/className string
set_attribute for allowlisted static string attributes
direct_edit.rule: Dry-run first. Apply only when exact data-ui-forge-source ownership is available and the editor reports syntax_reparse_passed. Rerender and browser-verify after every direct edit.

flow: preview reversible text/class/allowlisted-attribute operation in browser
commitSpec only when data-ui-forge-source is present
preview.rule: Browser preview is never source truth. It is a reversible decision surface; source mutation occurs only through a validated source edit followed by browser proof.

precision_edit.runtime_owner_rule: If a static source edit does not explain the rendered state, or the value is overwritten after load, trace the JavaScript/TypeScript runtime writer before editing again.

batch_edit.when: the same mechanically safe operation applies to multiple exact source-tagged intrinsic elements
rules: every selected element must have a unique exact data-ui-forge-source before commit
validate every source operation against the untouched tree before writing
apply later source positions first so earlier line/column pointers remain stable
restore every touched file if any apply step fails
rerender and re-probe every selected source identity after commit

css_style_edit.when: a visual spacing/color/type/border/shadow/layout property is owned by a static stylesheet rule
rules: browser preview uses temporary inline style only and must revert before source commit
normal JSX commitSpec remains not-ready for style_props
resolve the owning CSS rule from selected element id/class/tag evidence
refuse tied CSS ownership unless file + selector are explicit
patch only allowlisted visual declarations and reparse CSS before writing
committed DOM must not retain preview inline style
rerender and verify computed style, geometry, source identity, mobile layout, and console health

friction_learning.rule: Deduplicate recurring friction and promote repeated high-impact patterns into workflow/tool improvements.

conductor.role: Fail-closed AI run controller. It reads the workflow contract/state, reports the smallest next action, refuses phase completion when declared artifacts/proof are missing, and computes score/repair guidance from recorded evidence.

draft_workspaces.default_policy: live project remains untouched until draft evidence gate passes and accept succeeds
draft_workspaces.accept_conflict_policy: fail closed when a changed live path no longer matches the draft base snapshot
draft_workspaces.risky_change_policy: frontend-first; env/backend/api/database/schema/migration changes require explicit allow-risky escalation
draft_workspaces.runtime_artifact_filter: ignore .log/.pid/generated bytecode in base snapshots and change status so preview servers do not create fake draft diffs

when: reuse a proven semantic brand/theme across projects
persist a project-native token system as machine-readable AI context
compare or seed draft directions using an existing design language
extract_rules: extract only root-level CSS custom properties with provenance
refuse conflicting token definitions rather than choosing arbitrarily
do not infer missing brand tokens from raw scattered values
apply_rules: update only matching existing semantic custom properties
never use blind global color/value replacement
fail closed on missing or ambiguous target tokens by default
allow partial application only when explicitly reviewed and requested
write multiple stylesheets atomically with rollback on failure
rerender and run desktop/mobile proof plus design drift review after application

rules: base-state CSS ownership ignores pseudo selectors automatically
state requests require exactly the requested pseudo-state unless file + selector are explicit
combined or structural pseudo selectors require explicit ownership or the main coding path
state browser preview is simulated inline design preview and is not proof
after source commit exercise the real browser pseudo-state and verify computed style
recheck base and neighboring states for regressions
do not leave inline preview styles in committed DOM

state_matrix.required_for: substantial data-driven/stateful UI when loading/empty/error/success/recovery or equivalent states are relevant
rules: run each state in an isolated browser context on every declared representative viewport
missing required states fail validation before browser execution
use deterministic state-local network routes and response sequences for error/recovery proof when appropriate
declared mocked >=400 responses may be recorded as expected_failure_console_errors; unexpected console/page errors remain blockers
assert user-visible behavior and recovery rather than internal implementation flags
do not remove required states or weaken assertions to make a failing product pass

asset_slots.provider_rule: Use Synapse Image Studio or another authorized generator/import source when requested; UI Forge owns placement/provenance/source proof, not provider generation quality.
rules: direct deterministic lane accepts project-staged PNG/JPEG/WebP only
stage validates bytes/hash and does not mutate application source
preview only project-local /ui-forge-assets/ URLs and require successful image decode
revert preview before source commit
commit requires exact data-ui-forge-source targeting intrinsic img with static src
dynamic src, non-img targets, SVG, integrity mismatch, and path escapes fail closed
referenced assets cannot be deleted through staging cleanup
after commit verify natural dimensions, alt text, layout, stable source identity, desktop/mobile and console health
